result.instructions: Tools for Aqarsas, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What was the total value of residential deals in Riyadh's Al-Narjis district in May 2026?"; "Show the 10 most expensive commercial transactions in Jeddah this year."; "Find recent deals near the property with RER number 1234567890000000.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Aqarsas data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run aqarsas_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run aqarsas_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run aqarsas_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. aqarsas_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: aqarsas_search_transactions
tools.title: Search real estate transactions
tools.description: Search registered Saudi real estate transactions by date, region, city, district, plan, unit, category, property type, price and area. The API returns up to 5,000 matching rows (a random 5,000 when more match); this tool returns the first `limit` of them. Each row has the date, category, property kind, price per m², total price, area, location, plan and unit, and a non-standard flag such as mortgage or gift. Aqarsas API: POST /transactions/.

calendar.description: Calendar for the dates in the reply and for start_date/end_date: gregorian (default) or hijri.

start_date.description: Start of the date range, yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: End of the date range, yyyy-mm-dd.

category.description: Category: سكني residential, تجاري commercial, زراعي agricultural.

dtype.description: Property type in Arabic, for example أرض فضاء (vacant land), شقة (apartment), مبنى (building).

state.description: Region ID: 0 Riyadh, 1 Makkah, 2 Medina, 3 Al-Qasim, 4 Eastern, 5 Asir, 6 Tabuk, 7 Ha'il, 8 Northern Borders, 9 Jizan, 10 Najran, 11 Al-Bahah, 12 Al-Jawf.

city.description: Exact city name in Arabic, for example الرياض (Riyadh).

min_meter_price.description: Minimum price per m², in SAR.

max_meter_price.description: Maximum price per m², in SAR.

min_deal_price.description: Minimum total deal value, in SAR.

max_deal_price.description: Maximum total deal value, in SAR.

hai.description: District (حي) name in Arabic, for example النرجس (Al-Narjis).

hai_exact_match.description: true = exact district name; false (default) = fuzzy match, recommended.

m566.description: Plan number (مخطط) as text, for example "2670".

m566_exact_match.description: true = exact plan number; false (default) = fuzzy match, recommended.

unit.description: Unit or parcel number (قطعة) as text, for example "47".

unit_exact_match.description: true = exact unit number; false (default) = fuzzy match, recommended.

limit.description: How many rows to return from the API result (default 100, max 5000).

tools.name: aqarsas_get_market_stats
tools.title: Get market statistics
tools.description: Aggregate Saudi real estate deal statistics: the number of deals, the total deal value, or the total area, broken down by category and property type, for a date range and a region, city or district. If hai is given, city is required. Aqarsas API: POST /stats/.

stat_type.description: What to total: number_of_deals, value_of_deals (SAR, default) or area_of_deals (m²).

calendar.description: Calendar for the dates in the reply and for start_date/end_date: gregorian (default) or hijri.

start_date.description: Start of the date range, yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: End of the date range, yyyy-mm-dd.

state.description: Region ID: 0 Riyadh, 1 Makkah, 2 Medina, 3 Al-Qasim, 4 Eastern, 5 Asir, 6 Tabuk, 7 Ha'il, 8 Northern Borders, 9 Jizan, 10 Najran, 11 Al-Bahah, 12 Al-Jawf.

city.description: Exact city name in Arabic, for example الرياض (Riyadh).

hai.description: District (حي) name in Arabic, for example النرجس (Al-Narjis).

tools.name: aqarsas_get_top_transactions
tools.title: Get top transactions
tools.description: Rank Saudi real estate transactions by total deal price, price per m², or area, highest or lowest first, for a date range and a region, city or district. Date sorting is not offered here. Aqarsas API: POST /toptransactions/.

calendar.description: Calendar for the dates in the reply and for start_date/end_date: gregorian (default) or hijri.

start_date.description: Start of the date range, yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: End of the date range, yyyy-mm-dd.

state.description: Region ID: 0 Riyadh, 1 Makkah, 2 Medina, 3 Al-Qasim, 4 Eastern, 5 Asir, 6 Tabuk, 7 Ha'il, 8 Northern Borders, 9 Jizan, 10 Najran, 11 Al-Bahah, 12 Al-Jawf.

city.description: Exact city name in Arabic, for example الرياض (Riyadh).

hai.description: District (حي) name in Arabic, for example النرجس (Al-Narjis).

hai_exact_match.description: true = exact district name; false (default) = fuzzy match, recommended.

sort_by.description: Sort field: s3r total deal price (default), s3ralmtr price per m², area.

sort_by_ascending.description: false (default) = highest first; true = lowest first.

results_n.description: How many transactions to return (default 50, max 5000).

tools.name: aqarsas_get_property_details
tools.title: Get property details
tools.description: Look up a land plot or property and return up to 5 matching records, each with its full transaction history (up to 100 deals per record). Use rer_realestate_number when known; otherwise give state, city, m566 and unit, and area to rank close matches. Spatial fields (coordinates, elevation, zoning) appear only for accounts with spatial access. Aqarsas API: POST /propertydetails/.

rer_realestate_number.description: Real estate registry (RER) number. When given, state, city, m566 and unit are not needed.

state.description: Region ID: 0 Riyadh, 1 Makkah, 2 Medina, 3 Al-Qasim, 4 Eastern, 5 Asir, 6 Tabuk, 7 Ha'il, 8 Northern Borders, 9 Jizan, 10 Najran, 11 Al-Bahah, 12 Al-Jawf.

city.description: Exact city name in Arabic, for example الرياض (Riyadh).

m566.description: Plan number (مخطط) as text, for example "2670".

unit.description: Unit or parcel number (قطعة) as text, for example "47".

area.description: Area in m². Optional but recommended: matches within ±15% are ranked closest first.

tools.name: aqarsas_find_nearby_transactions
tools.title: Find nearby transactions
tools.description: Find recent deals on properties near a reference property, for comparable-sales analysis. The reference is identified by rer_realestate_number, or by state, city, m566 and unit (exactly one match is required). RER deal ids are masked by the API. Aqarsas API: POST /nearbytransactions/.

rer_realestate_number.description: Real estate registry (RER) number. When given, state, city, m566 and unit are not needed.

state.description: Region ID: 0 Riyadh, 1 Makkah, 2 Medina, 3 Al-Qasim, 4 Eastern, 5 Asir, 6 Tabuk, 7 Ha'il, 8 Northern Borders, 9 Jizan, 10 Najran, 11 Al-Bahah, 12 Al-Jawf.

city.description: Exact city name in Arabic, for example الرياض (Riyadh).

m566.description: Plan number (مخطط) as text, for example "2670".

unit.description: Unit or parcel number (قطعة) as text, for example "47".
